title: The Service That Won't Start
story: The payments API keeps failing to start after a deploy. systemctl just says it failed.
goal: Find why payments-api fails and fix it so the service is active.

payments-api: Nov 24 02:01:11 host payments-api[3001]: missing environment file /etc/payments/api.env

hints: systemctl status shows the last log lines. What does the log say is missing?
Create the missing file (touch), then start the service again.

Run:
systemctl status payments-api
journalctl -u payments-api
touch /etc/payments/api.env
systemctl restart payments-api
socratic: What must exist before the service can start?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
